title: Buff and event icons from a glyph library, validated as content assets
player_outcome: Every buff and debuff has a readable 32 px Terraria-style icon: a heart with a plus for Regeneration, a shield for Ironskin, a flame for On Fire!, and so on. Debuffs have a red frame. Invasions have icons for the progress panel.
design:
New tools/textures/ui_glyphs.py and ui_glyphs_b.py: 16×16 ASCII glyphs.
- Buffs: heart_plus, shield, sword, bow, magic_star, flame, poison_drop, blood_drop, skull, snowflake, boot, pickaxe, brick, eye, gem, feather, bubble, sun, campfire, lantern, minion, fist, rage, food, chain, swirl, ice_cube, water, honey, obsidian_skull, crosshair.
- Events: moon, pumpkin, present, pirate_flag, ufo, goblin, slime, pillar, crystal.

New tools/textures/buff_icons.json maps each of the 39 buff ids to {glyph, fg, bg}. New tools/textures/event_icons.json does the same for each event (all nine with a killGoal at minimum). These are tool recipes; game content stays in data/.

build_ui.py (from P2-02) gains a `buffs` and an `events` pass.
- Each icon: glyph upscaled ×2, 1 px outline, bevelled 32×32 square in bg; debuffs (Debuff=true in data) get a 2 px red frame.
- Output: assets/icons/buffs/<Icon ?? id>.png and assets/icons/events/<Icon ?? id>.png.
- `--check` parses data via data/manifest.json (reuse load_json from build_icons.py). It fails when any buff or event has no recipe or no output file.
Core: add `string? Icon` to EventDef. Add AssetPaths.BuffIcon(BuffDef) => assets/icons/buffs/{Icon ?? Id}.png and AssetPaths.EventIcon(EventDef).

ContentValidator.World.cs:
- ValidateProjectilesAndBuffs: `ctx.Asset(b, AssetPaths.BuffIcon(b), "icon")` for every buff.
- ValidateEvents: the same for events with KillGoal > 0.
- `Strata.Tools validate` already supplies AssetExists, so a missing icon becomes a CI error.
New game/UI/StatusIcons.cs: caches `BuffIcons.Get(BuffDef)` and `EventIcons.Get(EventDef)`, falling back to a coloured square with the first letter.
data_changes: EventDef gains optional `icon` (defaults to the id); no data edits required
tests: ContentValidatorTests: a buff whose icon file is missing (via an AssetExists predicate) reports an 'icon asset' error
verification: Visual check of the generated icon PNGs in an image viewer
risks: Buffs added by P3 or P4 then need a recipe line, or CI fails. That is intended, and --check prints the exact missing id.
